scenarios.name: station-offered-with-another-creature
scenarios.why: Station is an activated ability that taps another creature; with an untapped creature available it is offered as a sorcery during turn 1's first main phase.

scenarios.name: station-not-offered-without-another-creature
scenarios.why: Station requires tapping ANOTHER creature; the Spacecraft alone (not a creature below 8 charge counters) has no legal tap candidate, so it is not offered.
